messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Cannot open the connect
parts:
Hi James,

Could it be that files are too big for your computer to process, if yes try:
  • do.parallel = FALSE
  • chunksize = 0.5
Could it be that the connection with files is not stable for testing purposes make sure the files are stored in a reliable location and not on a shared drive that is connected with a weak network link.

If that does not address the issue then it would be good if you could try to reproduce the error with the code below. This tries to read all parts of each file similarly to how GGIR does it.

Best, Vincent

path = "file_path"
fnames = dir(path, full.names = TRUE)
for (fn in fnames) {
  print(fn)
  k = 1
  step = 10000
  while (k > 0) {
    AX3 = GGIRread::readAxivity(filename = fn, desiredtz = "Europe/London", start = k, end = k + step - 1)
    if (!is.null(AX3$data)) {
      k = k + step
    } else {
      k = -1
    }
  }
}
